Indirect FIFO Status 0

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x18c
Size:
0x4
Source:
usb_ocp_recovery_reg.rdl

Description

INDIRECT_FIFO_STATUS bytes 0-3. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 INDIRECT_FIFO_STATUS command summary, with USB-specific sticky status bits following usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:16] RESERVED_31_16 r 0x0 Reserved
[15:8] REGION_TYPE r 0x0 Region type
[7:2] RESERVED_7_2 r 0x0 Reserved status bits
[1] FULL r 0x0 FIFO Full
[0] EMPTY r 0x1 FIFO Empty

Field Descriptions

RESERVED_31_16 - Reserved

Bytes 2-3 are reserved. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 INDIRECT_FIFO_STATUS command summary.

REGION_TYPE - Region type

Byte 1 reports the selected FIFO region type. The current USB implementation returns 0x00 for code space. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 INDIRECT_FIFO_STATUS command summary and usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv.

RESERVED_7_2 - Reserved status bits

Byte 0 bits 7:2 are reserved in the OCP Recovery INDIRECT_FIFO_STATUS command (Sec 9.2 defines only bit 0 empty and bit 1 full). Caliptra-specific FIFO status (region reset / overflow / image done) lives in the CALIPTRA_STATUS register outside the OCP command aperture.

FULL - FIFO Full

Byte 0 bit 1 indicates the FIFO is full. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 INDIRECT_FIFO_STATUS command summary.

EMPTY - FIFO Empty

Byte 0 bit 0 indicates the FIFO is empty. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 INDIRECT_FIFO_STATUS command summary.
